spec.name: Monocoque
spec.role: survival cell / chassis tub with nose and cockpit opening
spec.notes: Tapered loft from wide rear section (X=-3700, 900 wide x 700 high, Z 30-730) to narrow nose tip (X=+550, 200 wide x 200 high, Z 30-230, flat vertical tip face that the front wing mount touches). Flat bottom at Z=30 sits on floor top face. Open cockpit cut from top, approx X -2300 to -1500, 500 wide, with raised rim 60 mm high around opening. Flat vertical rear face at X=-3700 for rear wing supports. Half-width 450 is well inside the 950 mm limit.

script_body:
import math


def sec(part, x, w, zb, zt, c, name, r=None, cb=None):
    # flat bottom at zb (never below), bottom corner chamfer cb, top corners
    # either chamfer c (straight, subdivided) or rounded with radius r.
    # every section has the same point count (14) for the loft.
    h = w / 2.0
    if cb is None:
        cb = c
    n = 4
    right = []
    left = []
    for k in range(n + 1):
        t = k / float(n)
        if r is not None:
            a = t * math.pi / 2.0
            right.append((x, h - r + r * math.cos(a), zt - r + r * math.sin(a)))
            b = math.pi / 2.0 + t * math.pi / 2.0
            left.append((x, -h + r + r * math.cos(b), zt - r + r * math.sin(b)))
        else:
            right.append((x, h - c * t, zt - c + c * t))
            left.append((x, -h + c - c * t, zt - c * t))
    pts = [(x, -h + cb, zb), (x, h - cb, zb), (x, h, zb + cb)]
    pts += right
    pts += left
    pts.append((x, -h, zb + cb))
    return part.section("x", x, pts, name)


def build(part):
    p = part.p
    W = p["rear_width"]
    H = p["rear_height"]
    nw = p["nose_tip_width"]
    nh = p["nose_tip_height"]
    rim = p["cockpit_rim_height"]
    cl = p["cockpit_opening_length"]
    cw = p["cockpit_opening_width"]
    zb = 30.0
    x_rear = 550.0 - p["length"]

    profs = [
        sec(part, x_rear, W, zb, zb + H, 80, "SK_sec_rear"),
        sec(part, -2600, W * 0.97, zb, zb + H - 40, 75, "SK_sec_cockpit_rear"),
        sec(part, -1400, W * 0.85, zb, zb + H - 110, 65, "SK_sec_cockpit_front"),
        sec(part, -400, W * 0.55, zb, zb + H * 0.48, 50, "SK_sec_nose_root", r=110.0, cb=30.0),
        sec(part, 550, nw, zb, zb + nh, 30, "SK_sec_nose_tip", r=60.0, cb=15.0),
    ]
    part.loft(profs, "LF_tub", op="new")

    # cockpit centre
    x0 = -2300.0
    x1 = x0 + cl
    # raised rim block (interior removed by cockpit cut)
    zr0 = 560.0
    zr_top = 680.0 + rim
    sk = part.sketch(part.plane("z", zr0), "SK_cockpit_rim")
    part.polygon(sk, [
        (x0 - 60, -cw / 2 - 60, zr0), (x1 + 60, -cw / 2 - 60, zr0),
        (x1 + 60, cw / 2 + 60, zr0), (x0 - 60, cw / 2 + 60, zr0),
    ])
    part.extrude(part.profile(sk), zr_top - zr0, "EX_cockpit_rim", op="join")

    # cockpit opening cut from above
    zc = 760.0
    skc = part.sketch(part.plane("z", zc), "SK_cockpit_opening")
    part.polygon(skc, [
        (x0, -cw / 2, zc), (x1, -cw / 2, zc),
        (x1, cw / 2, zc), (x0, cw / 2, zc),
    ])
    part.extrude(part.profile(skc), -(zc - 140.0), "CUT_cockpit", op="cut")
